regime_context: The detector shows a semiconductor/AI-infrastructure leadership cluster (AI Infrastructure, Memory/HBM, Semi Equipment, AI Semi all eligible, trend- or mixed-trend) with fairly tight breadth, while most of the rest of the field is ineligible or mean-reverting. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped on this market (gate_helps true), so trend discipline is meaningful here, but the momentum ranks themselves are a focus lens, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Memory, HBM & Storage confirms a leadership handoff over AI Infrastructure: the condition that would retire this watch is a close where the memory theme's rank score exceeds AI-infra's score for three consecutive sessions, or where the rotation margin (currently 0.422) compresses below 0.15. Until then the AI-infra leader is intact.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: The headline leader ranks #1 with eligible true, mixed-trend Hurst, high breadth (0.875), and a durability_bar of 0.71 — the highest-score eligible theme in a market where the absolute-trend gate helps. The rotation radar shows a narrowing eligible field (20/49), with AI-infra not crowded (cz 0.84) and not one-narrative, so this is a concentration-in-leadership lean rather than a blow-off. Supporting legs are rank + durability + trend-gate eligibility.
theses.dissent: AI-infra has a mixed Hurst tag (not a clean trend), and the rotation margin to the challenger is 0.422 — leadership could stutter if the memory/HBM challenger keeps climbing; momentum rank has no validated edge on its own.

falsifier.text: SMH closes 6% below its 2026-10-05 level before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The #2 challenger scores 1.873, has the cleanest trend tag in the top cluster (hurst 'trend'), decent breadth (0.75), and a slightly higher durability_bar (0.72) than the leader. It is not crowded (cz 0.15). The case is a continuation lean on the strongest-trend challenger to the leader, not a crowding-fade call against AI-infra.
theses.dissent: It shares the SMH proxy with the leader and semiconductor equipment — concentration in one basket means idiosynratic drawdown risk; rank-IC is weak so the #2 slot does not confer alpha.

falsifier.text: SMH lags the S&P 500 by 5% over the 20-day window

theses.subject: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
theses.thesis: Rank #3 with the highest durability_bar in the semiconductor cluster (0.78) and the widest breadth (0.938) among eligible AI/semi names. It has mixed Hurst rather than clean trend, which caps conviction, but the persistence leg (durability) is the strongest in the top five eligible themes.
theses.dissent: Mixed Hurst means the trend is not clean; cz 0.98 is the highest among top semi names, bordering the crowding caution even if not flagged crowded, so downside symmetry is a concern.

falsifier.text: SMH falls more than 4% relative to the benchmark before the check-by date
